name: cubicle
description: Cubicle: a live pixel-art office for your AI agents (Paperclip, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI). See who works, who needs you, who failed; KPI board, Telegram alerts, HD themes. Zero dependencies, read-only.

paragraphs: A live pixel-art office for your AI agents. Works with Paperclip, Claude Code, or any tool that can write a small JSON file.

Your agents get a desk. When one starts working it walks over, sits down and starts typing, with its current task floating above its head. When it needs you, it raises a hand. When it finishes it goes back to the lounge for a coffee. If it hits an error, its screen flashes red.
features: Zero dependencies. One small Node.js file plus one HTML page. No build step, no image assets.
Not tied to one platform. Paperclip, Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI are built in; anything else plugs in through a tiny JSON feed.
GitHub Copilot Desktop and CLI sessions can join the office through the local exporter and hook examples.
Runs anywhere Node runs. npx, a clone, a systemd unit, or a browser tab pointed at the hosted demo.

Themes. The classic pixel office, or HD rooms: a holding HQ, a plaza office, a warehouse, a factory, a space base and a military operations room. Pick one from the ⚙ menu; a theme is one file anyone can add.

whatItDoes.text: A live pixel-art office for your AI agents. Works with Paperclip, Claude Code, or any tool that can write a small JSON file.

requirements.text: On the computer, install Tailscale from tailscale.com/download and sign in (Google, Microsoft or Apple account).
On the phone, install Tailscale from the App Store or Google Play, sign in with the same account and allow the VPN.
